comments.content: The second mock for `/requirements.txt` without basic_auth will match requests with credentials too (since it has no auth matcher). This could cause the 401 response to be returned even when credentials are provided. Add `.and(basic_auth(username, password).not())` or use `Mock::given(method("GET")).and(path("/requirements.txt")).and(basic_auth(username, password).not())` to ensure it only matches unauthenticated requests.
